'''December 1999 Milwaukee tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Egomania Comics, Milwaukee, WI on 18 December 1999. It is known from Ryan Fojtik's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d152">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-20-milwaukee-wi-12-18-99d152/ milwaukee-wi-12-18-99], DeckTech (Ryan "XjedeyeX" Fojtik, 20 December 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-20-milwaukee-wi-12-18-99d152/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 December 1999
* '''Site:''' Egomania Comics, Milwaukee, WI
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 9
